writeLock.rule: Only A5 mutates Figma. Other agents are read-only for Figma and write only their owned repo files.

agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.role: Integrate state, manifest, indexes, and handoff.

agents.name: Figma Reverse Engineer
agents.role: Extract source node structure, text, layer roles, and screenshots.

agents.name: Token Cartographer
agents.role: Map primitive, semantic, typography, effect, surface, and component tokens.

agents.name: Component Architect
agents.role: Design reusable component families, variants, and promotion queue.

agents.name: Asset Harvester
agents.role: Catalog images, graphs, tables, fonts, evidence captures, and provenance.

agents.name: Figma Slide Builder
agents.role: Only Figma writer. Build source-preserving, componentized, blind, or derivative frames.

agents.name: Visual QA Judge
agents.role: Compare screenshots, detect clipping, flattening, drift, and gate failures.

agents.name: AI Process Librarian
agents.role: Record prompts, build logs, failure loops, and decisions.

agents.name: Evidence Recorder
agents.role: Append source/evidence/telemetry records and verify no evidence gaps remain.
